title: Perma Speed
description: Permanently applies speed to all players.
body:
## Perma Speed
A lightweight mod that applys infinite speed 2 to all players which can be useful for servers with parcore, main lobbies and pvp.

This plugin has been designed so even if a player drinks milk or clear the effect they cannot bypass it.

If there is a version that does not exist please email me here so i know to add it: zwhseton@gmail.com
